instruction: CORRECTNESS R1 review of WP-SCP-022 slice 020P (RULE-001 Phase 2 — implement SCP-R-004 + cut v1.1.0) at branch feature/wp-scp-022-020p-scp-r-004-implementation, HEAD commit `9f8639d`. The slice surface is large but mostly mechanical translation from RULE-001 (the canonical specification merged at PR #89, commit 25db685) into Rego + tests + workflow + version + docs. Verify CORRECTNESS exhaustively. Specifically: (1) policies/SCP-R-004.rego matches RULE-001 §3.1 match conditions + §3.4 implementation sketch + §3.3 annotation contract: own scp_r_004_is_waiver_payload + scp_r_004_has_nonempty_string + scp_r_004_has_url + scp_r_004_truncate_reason predicates (NOT cross-rule scp_r_002_* per SAFE-MAJ-001 closure); regex `https?://[^\s]+`; sprintf message includes index + entry rule_id + entry finding_id + truncated reason. (2) The truncation predicate scp_r_004_truncate_reason: `count(reason) <= 80` returns reason as-is; `count(reason) > 80` returns `concat('', [substring(reason, 0, 79), '…'])`. Verify `substring(reason, 0, 79)` actually returns 79 chars (Rego substring semantics: substring(s, start, length)) — this gives 79 chars of body + 1 char ellipsis = 80 total. Verify the ellipsis is U+2026 (three-dot ellipsis) and not three ASCII dots. (3) Conftest tests at policies/tests/scp_r_004_test.rego: 19 cases. Verify each case actually exercises what its docstring claims. Specifically the meta-waiver test: the waivers data has `rule_id: SCP-R-004` and the waiver's OWN reason contains a URL — verify the test would FAIL if the meta-waiver's reason had no URL (which would mean the meta-waiver itself fires SCP-R-004 against the waivers data). Verify the truncation test (test_scp_r_004_truncates_long_reason_in_message) actually exercises the >80-char path AND that the assertion `not contains(results[0].message, "by quite a bit and should be truncated")` validates the truncation cut point. (4) Conflict-gate fixtures at tests/conflict_gate/fixtures/SCP-R-004/{allow,deny}/{input.json, expected-verdict.json}. Verify expected-verdict.json shape matches the fixtures for SCP-R-001/002 (same `rule_id`, `file`, `verdict`, `reason` keys). (5) Python evaluator at tests/conflict_gate/test_conflict_gate.py `_evaluate_scp_r_004_python`: verify URL_PATTERN regex `https?://\S+` is semantically equivalent to Rego `https?://[^\s]+` for the ASCII fixture corpus (they should be — Python re `\S` and RE2 `[^\s]` agree on ASCII). (6) Workflow integration at .github/workflows/policy-check.yml: WARN_BASELINE_RULES = {'SCP-R-004'} set; warn-baseline branch emits `::warning::` annotations; effective_denies excludes warn-baseline rules; threshold check `if effective_denies and SCP_THRESHOLD == 'deny'` does NOT include warn_baseline_findings. Verify the YAML is syntactically valid (the change is inside a python3 heredoc — verify the heredoc shell-escaping is correct). (7) version-manifest.json: version 1.0.1 → 1.1.0; minor 1.0 → 1.1; major 1; released_at 2026-05-02. Verify the JSON is valid. (8) docs/releases/v1.1.0.md: covers what ships, what changes for adopters, files in release, how adopters can verify. Verify RULE-001 references are correct. (9) docs/adoption/ADOPT-001-project-onboarding.md §12.7.14: 3 adopter response options + meta-waiver shape requirement. Verify the rule-config disable example YAML is syntactically valid + matches schemas/rule-config.schema.json. (10) RULE-TEMPLATE.md §5 amendment: residual-bypass guidance for syntactic-pattern rules. Verify the worked-example pointer to RULE-001 §5 case 5 is accurate. (11) README.md §3 amendment: 'new domain' definition. Verify the same-input-schema framing matches RULE-001 §9 framing. (12) DISPATCH-NOTE.md scope decision is internally consistent. (13) Verify NO regressions on SCP-R-001/002/003 — read those rule files briefly to confirm the SCP-R-004 changes don't introduce any package-level naming collisions (e.g. duplicate `scp_r_004_*` symbols). (14) The truncation '…' character: verify the Rego file uses `…` (U+2026) not three ASCII periods; verify the test assertion matches. NEVER recommend descoping; propose inline-fix or file as TF-020P-NNN. Output to docs/reviews/WP-SCP-022/dispatches/020p/review-correctness.json.
